refs.source_direction: Promotional catalog or discovery listing for paid and free Excel/Google Sheets/AI-automation live lectures. It drives funnel traffic to LIVE pages.
scope: Curricular pattern: a multi-week challenge arc moves from AI-assisted Sheets automation to Apps Script apps and then to agent teams.
Automation stack signal: Sheets + ARRAYFORMULA/QUERY + Apps Script + a messaging notification channel.
Cadence signal: a weekly live series with tier labels.

refs.source_direction: Index of 13 how-to tip posts with copy-paste prompts and free files or tools. The tone is casual and persuasive ('그냥 복붙해서 쓰세요').
scope: Staged generation for token economy: plan → design MD → 1–2 sample slides → full output, instead of a one-shot 10-slide request.
Ask for HTML instead of a .pptx file when you want fast iteration and sharing, and compare trade-offs per item.
Add an image-slot placeholder block to prompts so photos can be swapped in later.
Use a DESIGN.md as a reusable design spec rather than a bare template.
refs.authority_ceiling: discovery_index_only. Any single tip is at most a candidate heuristic, not canonical.

refs.source_direction: A release-note and upload log that signals ongoing product maintenance and member value. It is a self-reported maintenance record.
scope: UI-automation and scraping dependencies (messenger apps, shopping search pages, third-party auth) break on upstream changes. Plan for a maintenance cadence.
Guard formulas against edge cases such as 0% progress giving #DIV/0!, single-row array filters giving #VALUE!, and holiday dates breaking an FX lookup.
Version and changelog discipline: dated, semver-like entries per tool.
Remove fragile features for compatibility, for example the pivot-table dashboard sheet was removed and conditional formatting was removed for readability.
refs.authority_ceiling: observational_evidence_of_a_vendor_changelog_only. It is not a standard or canonical.

refs.source_direction: Instructional and promotional. It tells readers to paste a macro and run it to recolor a whole deck, and it advertises 'free distribution'. The tone leans on convenience.
scope: Processing order: theme → master → layouts → slides, recursing into groups, tables and SmartArt.
Safety UX: work on a copy, show a confirmation summary, offer a PREVIEW_ONLY dry run, and report a changed-count.
Hue-family mapping with tolerance, partial hue retention, and skipping low-saturation neutrals (MIN_SATURATION).
Fall back to exact-match mode when the source color is achromatic.
refs.authority_ceiling: experiment_candidate_requiring_security_and_functional_review. It must not run on production decks and is not canonical.

refs.source_direction: A resource and discovery index. It supports the publisher's DESIGN.md and AI-design workflows (284 systems) and likely drives traffic and engagement.
scope: Describe a design system compactly as accent count, base surface, corner radius, button shape and signature layout. Single-accent-color systems appear repeatedly.
Restraint pattern: neutral base plus one accent color used only for the key actions.
Distinguishing descriptors (corner radius, angle, shape language) turn into prompt-ready constraints.
Organize references by industry and brand type.
refs.authority_ceiling: inspiration_reference_only. It is not an authoritative brand spec and not a canonical design token source.
